meta.title: One decision point, six mutations, six criteria

lanes.label: The only place a call is judged

cards.title: Six mutations, each must trip one named criterion
items: A new frontend carrying its own build_edges → I1 (the set of write points)
Keeping the wiring but inlining a lookup → I5 (the lowercase-lookup fingerprint)
Computing the name inside the attribution code → I4 (provenance must be structural, from the AST)
Keeping the wiring, inlining without a lookup → I1b (the shape of the write point)
Registering one extra language → I6 forward (every registered frontend must call the shared token)
Pointing the registry at a misspelled function → I6 reverse (an entry must resolve to a real callable)

cards.title: Why I1b exists
items: I1 alone looks only at the set of write points
A change that keeps the shared call and also appends inline stays invisible to I1
The first red-path probe proved it: the mutation was caught by I5, so I1b had no independent witness until a fourth mutation was added

cards.title: Behaviour preservation, before any of this
items: The old tree is exported with git archive HEAD and the same commands run on both sides
Ten artefacts (five command pairs of JSON + stdout) are compared byte for byte
Probe-introduced variables are masked and counted; declared differences print their values; everything else is red
